lists: list=allimages (every file, current revision: url, size, mime, sha1, timestamp)
generator=allimages + prop=fileusage|categories (pages embedding each file; file categories)
generator=allimages + prop=revisions|linkshere (file description wikitext; pages linking to it)
generator=allpages, namespace 0, non-redirects + current wikitext, revision IDs and categories
action=expandtemplates for song Title values built from templates
scope.notes: One candidate per file of list=allimages. Roles and games come from song templates (Template:Song = original game, Template:SongUV = Dynamix Universe), page usage, gallery/link captions, reviewed list pages, file categories and, only when nothing else applies, filename conventions; evidence is pooled by file title with wikis:miraheze. Where no page establishes a role or game, an archivist review (visual inspection of the bytes, scripts/wikis/reviews.json, pinned to the reviewed SHA-1) may; its evidence is quoted and its song mappings are 'inferred'. Accepted candidates that are not downloaded yet are 'pending' with reason 'awaiting_download'.
